disposition: Retain every comparison. A failed check is a model-form disagreement, not a reason to alter inputs or tolerances.
purpose: Extend the P5-03 plate comparison across free-diameter/thickness ratio and Poisson ratio so the released validity envelope is read from solved, mesh-converged evidence instead of an unsourced constant, with the fixed-edge margin-governing stress compared through its convergent reaction-moment resultant.

source_inputs.linearity_note: Both compared models are linear, so every reported relative error is independent of the applied pressure magnitude.
